subtitle: BizHawk
_ap_world_name_source: audit_world_name.py read the world itself; it declares game = 'Castlevania - Harmony of Dissonance' (manifest said 'Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance'). The world is the authority.
description: Dracula's castle across two layers as a multiworld. Relics, spell books and furniture are shuffled across the session.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game - no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until the RAM map has been MEASURED in-game. Until then London warns at launch.
_requires_source: GBA title - the game lives on a cartridge the player owns

rom.description: A Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance ROM of the US version specifically -- either the original cartridge dump or the Castlevania Advance Collection rip (the latter has no audio)
rom._description_source: world source: LiquidCat64/LiquidCatipelago @ CVHoDis, worlds/cvhodis -- read from the world's own code
rom._size_note: Not measured. London reads size 0 as 'unknown' and matches on MD5 alone, which is the stronger check.
rom._md5_source: world source: LiquidCat64/LiquidCatipelago @ CVHoDis, worlds/cvhodis -- read from the world's own code -- the accepted-dump list the world validates the player's file against

apworld._source: game list plus the world's own repository

patch._source: audit_patch_model.py read the world: class CVHoDisProcedurePatch(APProcedurePatch, APTokenMixin)

_note: The setup guide states the patch extension as '.apcvcotm', which is Circle of the Moon's. The same author wrote both worlds, so this looks like a copy-paste slip in their documentation. The CODE says '.apcvhodis' in both rom.py and client.py, and the code is what runs.
_patch_extension_source: read from the compiled world at cvhodis.apworld: adds new steps ['apply_patches', 'fix_guardian_drops'] in cvhodis/rom.py:CVHoDisPatchExtensions

world_by.name: LiquidCat64
world_by._source: the address this world is published at, from apworld.url in this manifest
world_by._licence_source: read from LiquidCat64/LiquidCatipelago's own LICENSE file, 2026-08-19 -- the MIT text; GitHub's classifier says 'Other' because the file carries extra wording, so the body was read rather than the label

credits._note: The game is the property of its publisher and is never distributed here; the player supplies their own copy. The Archipelago world is its author's work. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.
